caption: The drawing depicts a single brown clay flowerpot with decorative features set against a plain, light-colored background. The pot has a wide rim with a zigzag or saw-tooth edge and an embossed, circular band immediately below the rim. The pot itself tapers inward towards the middle before widening slightly at the base, and it has engraved horizontal lines and a floral pattern on its surface. The flowerpot sits in a matching saucer with a wavy, scalloped lip that echoes the decorative motif seen at the rim of the pot. The brown hue of the pot and saucer varies in intensity, showing shaded areas to give the objects a three-dimensional appearance. The artist's name, "Fritz Boehmer," is written in small capital letters near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Flower Pot
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
